A. Image-led pair (recommended)

Cost: low, one section rebuilt, photos swapped for always-visible ones. Risk: the two photos must match in tone; the old hover reveal goes. Why recommended: it keeps the approved two-tall-panels idea, fixes the hidden photo on phones, and demotes the price to one quiet line.
